found_at: https://www.vectara.com/ (favicon set linked from the page head)
notes: No SVG qualifies: the V's colour is a free-form gradient that Vectara only ships as a bitmap. Every Vectara SVG draws it over an embedded raster: the site header logo (a mask over a 72x66 WebP), docs.vectara.com/img/vectara_logo.svg (the current file, a 410x367 PNG in an SVG wrapper) and @vectara/vectara-ui's HeaderLogo (a 1572x1367 PNG inside a TSX). This 512px favicon is the largest standalone PNG Vectara publishes; it is a 256-colour PNG, so the gradient is dithered when zoomed, which does not show at 48px. If the reviewer wants a smoother copy, the 1572x1367 RGBA PNG embedded in @vectara/vectara-ui src/docs/components/HeaderLogo.tsx (downloads/vectara/npm_vectara-ui/) is the same bare V, but only as base64 inside source code. The gradient reads on both themes.
